name: Spring into Summit 2024

venue.name: Lawton C. Johnson Summit Middle School

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.
* We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event especially if you are new. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. Missing your group risks potential disqualification from the event.
* **Food and drinks are NOT permitted inside the gym**. You may eat in the cafeteria. We STRONGLY encourage you to venture to Summit Downtown to explore food options. There are a few restaurants within a ten minute walk, 2 min drive.
* Live results will be posted on WCA Live.
